csv_project_name: DEV for 2026 Affordable Housing Development Project
csv_scope_of_work: This Request for Proposals (RFP) makes available HOME-American Rescue Plan (HOME-ARP) funds awarded to the City of Albuquerque by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) to support the development of affordable rental housing for HOME-ARP qualifying populations identified in the City's HOME-ARP Allocation Plan. The City desires to leverage its investment by maximizing the amount of residential units to be developed on the 1.72-acre site. Therefore, competitive projects should propose between 40-100 units.

title: Developer for 2026 Affordable Housing Development Project
short_description: Design-build affordable housing development with 40 to 100 rental units in Albuquerque.
project_scope: Development of affordable rental housing on a 1.72-acre site using HOME-ARP funding. Competitive proposals should maximize residential yield and provide approximately 40 to 100 housing units.
services: Design-build/developer services for affordable housing development; development, design, and delivery of the residential project.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential building project with no indication of unusual structural complexity or long-span structures.
- Tender is aimed at design-build/developer services rather than specialized structural engineering.
- Affordable housing is generally less aligned with sbp's core focus on bridges, special structures, and architecturally demanding large buildings.
- Some relevance remains because it is a building project with a planning component.
fee_explanation: No explicit engineering fee is stated in the tender documents. Available information for a rough estimate: total construction cost is 6.6 million USD, project is a design-build/developer procurement for 40 to 100 affordable housing units on a 1.72-acre site.
